sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (07:47 – 14:30)

Response call from Council Wardens requesting assistance to move a vagrant in front of Smith and Caugheys.
Arrived at response location; Council had already sorted the matter and moved him along.
Response call from Council Wardens reporting a verbally aggressive male individual in front of Peter Alexander, requesting assistance for further escalation.
Arrived at response location, standing by to assist any further escalation with the male vagrant. Police has also arrived.
Continuing onwards due to the POI calming down and preparing to move along (captured on bodycam). Patrolling down Queen Street.
Welfare check Chemist Warehouse Wyndham Street, all clear.
Arrived corner Queen and Shortland Street, no issues.
Welfare check inside Imperial Lane, floor checks completed, no concerns.

Welfare check Metro Woolworths and Aotea Gifts, all clear.
Welfare check OK Gift Shop, all clear.
Arrived corner Customs and Albert Street intersection, no concerns.
Welfare check Albert Mart Convenience store and Discount Dairy.
Welfare check Good to Go Supermarket and Hollywood cafe, all clear.

Welfare check inside Queens Food Court, Munster Inn and Nandos, all clear.

Continuing patrols and commencing Echo Route.

Ippondo — female standing to the side of the store with multiple bags, unsure of her situation; will be nearby to ensure no issues arise. Strand Arcade welfare check complete, no issues.

Welfare check within Mid City shopping center, all clear.
Response call from Management requesting assistance to let him into the building.
Welfare check 77 Convenience store, Banh Mi, all clear.

Welfare check Unichem Pharmacy, McDonald's Queen, Mrs Higgins and Timezone, all clear.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (15:00 – 22:10)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Ops phone charged, commencing welfare sweeps heading up Queen Street.
Welfare checks on stores complete, no issues:
Aotea Square full sweep complete. Heading to Victoria Street via Elliot Street.
Elliot Street sweep complete, no issues. Continuing to Victoria Street.
Victoria Street welfare check complete, 77 Convenience clear. Heading to Cathedral.
Welfare check on the Cathedral complete. Heading to Commercial Bay via Albert Street.
Welfare check Albert Street clear, Albert Mart clear. Continuing to Commercial Bay.
Arrived Commercial Bay, commencing welfare sweeps.
Welfare sweep Commercial Bay, Commerce Street, Tyler Street complete. Heading to Chancery Square with welfare checks on lower Queen Street.
Welfare check Fort Street, Shortland Street and local stores on lower Queen Street complete. Heading to Chancery Square.

Response call from Albert Mart regarding a male vagrant causing a disturbance; no assistance needed as the owner sorted it but called to inform us. Advised the owner to call back if the vagrant returns and escalates.
Chancery Square welfare check complete. Heading back to Lorne Street while sweeping High Street.
Arriving Lorne Street, commencing welfare sweeps.
Welfare sweep Lorne Street complete. Heading to the Auckland Library.
Welfare check Auckland Library, no issues. Heading back to Queen Street to maintain presence. Standing by.
Response call from 77 Convenience Victoria Street requesting assistance to move vagrants ingesting alcohol and illegal substances outside the store.
Arrived 77 Convenience, situation sorted out with no escalations. Standing by Victoria Street as foot traffic is busy.
Big crowds arrived at Aotea Square Town Hall as Stan Walker is doing a performance dedicated to Matariki.
Heading back to HQ to prepare for shift handover.
Full sweep Upper Queen Street, McDonald's, 77 Convenience store, Avanis Chicken, Timezone, Chacha, Yuan Taste all clear. Heading to Aotea Square waiting for guard to return from assistance.
Arrived Aotea Square, commencing full sweep and keeping security presence known.
Full sweep Aotea Square, Myers Park all clear.
Going back to HQ to let guard in (requested by ASG management).
Arrived HQ, letting standby guard in, then continuing patrols on lower Queen Street doing full sweep.
Full sweep Fort Lane, welfare check all stores still open, all clear.
Full sweep Commercial Bay, Britomart McDonald's, guard all clear.
Welfare check Reign n Pour, all clear.
Removed alcohol from a male adult, all clear.
Heading back to HQ for guard handover then continue patrol.
Arrived HQ, standing by till guard starts.

Full welfare check on Wilson's car park on Elliot Street.
Continuing patrol down Queen Street towards Commercial Bay.
Welfare check past Wyndham Street, standing by showing presence.
Continuing patrol towards Commercial Bay Britomart.

Full sweep Britomart, welfare check Reign and Pour.
Britomart all clear, continuing patrol back towards Bar 101.

Arrived Bar 101, welfare check, standing by to show presence.
Standing by Bar 101 till closing then heading off to patrols.
Welfare check Bar 101, full sweep Elliot Stables, Darby Street, all clear.
Welfare check Victoria Street / 77 Convenience store, no issues.
Check in St Patrick's Cathedral church, Federal Street, all clear.
Full sweep Wyndham Street all clear. Patrolling down Albert Street heading to Britomart.
Full sweep Albert Street; arrived Britomart, commencing full sweep and standing by.
Full sweep Britomart and McDonald's, no issues. Heading down Fort Lane.
Check in Fort Street / Fort Lane, all clear.
Arrived Chancery Square walking up from High Street, all clear. Commencing Chancery sweep.
Full sweep Chancery Square, Freyberg Square all clear. Heading towards HQ for 30 minute break.
Arrived HQ, commencing break and responding to any calls that come through.
On standby at HQ for morning shift handover and ready to respond to calls.
